positive_cases.prompt: This checkpointed agent workflow failed after several tool calls. Replay the run and find the first state divergence.
A retryable event workflow produced the wrong final state. Use persisted events/checkpoints to debug it.

negative_cases.prompt: Explain this isolated stack trace from a pure function.

required_behaviors: pin failing run and source SHA
distinguish deterministic replay from nondeterministic re-execution
forbidden_behaviors: replay destructive production writes without approval
focus only on final symptom when earlier divergence is available
